name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd.
business_summary: Indian listed arm of Hitachi Energy (71.31% promoter), formerly ABB Power Products & Systems India. Makes power and traction transformers, HVDC converter stations and components, grid-connection solutions, power quality equipment, switchgear and services; serves utilities (PGCIL), renewables, data centres, rail and industry. Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026): revenue Rs 2,493.7 cr (+68.6%), EBITDA margin 16.0%, PAT Rs 294.2 cr (+123.5%), order intake Rs 5,096.5 cr, record backlog Rs 32,222.1 cr (company release). Financial year ends March. screener.in data was empty in the pack, so market cap (~Rs 1.25 lakh cr) is estimated from price Rs 28,130 x ~4.46 cr shares (model knowledge).

exposures.mechanism: Backlog Rs 32,222 cr is ~3x LTM-implied sales; HVDC, grid integration and transformers lead orders. +1 unit = +20% order intake -> ~+10% revenue over 12 months; incremental EBITDA ~45% of revenue on a 16% margin -> EBITDA +28%; persistence 0.5, EV/MCap ~1.0 -> ~+14, halved to +8 because growth is largely priced in (P/E likely >100).

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 2,493.7 cr +68.6%; EBITDA 16.0%; PAT Rs 294.2 cr +123.5%; backlog Rs 32,222.1 cr; data centres significant in orders

exposures.mechanism: PGCIL/state utilities fund HVDC corridors and substations; +10% capex growth -> +4% revenue -> EBITDA +11% (45% contribution) -> persistence 0.5 -> ~+5.

Release says data centres contributed significantly to Q1 orders; DC connections, power quality and transformers. +1 unit = +20% DC-linked demand (~20% of non-HVDC orders) -> +4% revenue -> EBITDA +11%; persistence 0.5 -> ~+5.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 2,493.7 cr +68.6%; EBITDA 16.0%; PAT Rs 294.2 cr +123.5%; backlog Rs 32,222.1 cr; data centres significant in orders

exposures.mechanism: Moves with global AI sentiment: Hitachi Energy India fell with AI-related stocks on 2026-10-13, 10-15 and 10-30 (up to 5-6%, Moneycontrol) and -6% on 2026-10-23. +10% AI capex growth -> sentiment/valuation +3.5.
Renewable evacuation, BESS (first 165 MW/330 MWh order), 900 GW non-fossil target by FY36 (company release). +1 unit -> +15% pipeline -> ~+4.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 2,493.7 cr +68.6%; EBITDA 16.0%; PAT Rs 294.2 cr +123.5%; backlog Rs 32,222.1 cr; data centres significant in orders

exposures.mechanism: Stronger support raises HVDC/grid connection solutions for renewable zones (Barmer-type projects).

Copper windings ~12% of costs; ~70% recovered by price-variation clauses; +10% -> cost +1.2%, 30% unrecovered = 0.36% -> EBITDA -2.2% at 16% OPM; persistence 0.25 -> ~-0.6, rounded -0.8 for export/fixed-price orders. Pack shows no significant link (not listed in top 12).
CRGO and structural steel ~8% of costs; +7% -> EBITDA -2.3% unrecovered 30% -> persistence 0.3 -> ~-0.3.

Imports from Hitachi Energy global (HVDC valves, components) are ~35% of materials; exports are 33.6% of non-HVDC orders (release), a partial natural hedge. +3% -> net unhedged cost +0.5% of revenue -> EBITDA -3% -> persistence 0.5 x 0.9 -> ~-1.
P/E >100 on a long-duration growth story (valuation partly offset by net cash). +25 bp -> ~-2.
FIIs 12.0% (rose to 12.4% in Jun-2026 quarter, now 11.96%); +$5bn/qtr inflows support high-multiple names.

Siemens Energy India, GE Vernova T&D, CG Power and imports add capacity; company asks for a 'level-playing-field policy' (release). +1 unit = 100 bp margin pressure -> EBITDA -6% at 16% OPM; persistence 0.7, prob 0.6 -> ~-4.
